items.title: Lars Edegran Interview, 1965-09-27
items.q: Crawford, I don't like Crawford playing at all. Either with a regular band or with a brass band.

ctx.x: I felt the Tormund players, well I noticed Paul Crawford seemed to be clowning or something because he felt he couldn't do anything else, you know, with a band. Yeah, yeah.
Crawford, I don't like Crawford playing at all. Either with a regular band or with a brass band.
What band did you hear him with?
